test_std_exception: test the pybind11 exceptions module to verify std::exception throws a RuntimeError with the correct message
test_error_already_set: test the pybind11 exceptions module to verify error_already_set translates to RuntimeError or ValueError based on flag
test_cross_module_exceptions: test cross-module exception propagation between pybind11 shared libraries for RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError, and StopIteration
test_custom: test custom C++ exception translation to Python types including MyException, standard exceptions, unknown exceptions, and exception subclassing
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling chains with try_catch and custom exception types
